traits.note: Plants of the World Online's account of the cactus family, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): tepals many, in several series grading from sepal-like outer ones to petal-like inner ones; a floral tube above the pericarpel, which holds the inferior ovary. For the saguaro, a description on the SEINet and NEON portals adds a pericarpel and floral tube 6 to 10 cm long, covered with scales.
